UI reports all in stock. One example SKU for Clean Cotton `24656548580068192697` (UI observation only). Proposed candle-only group locally calculates 1×9=9 combinations under Printify's observed rule, but no authorization/rights/publishing readiness inferred.

Sweatshirt `6ad647d24f4a65e4300211e5`: current read-only table showed S–5XL (8 size rows), 5 colors S–3XL and 4 colors 4XL–5XL; exact color labels inaccessible. Earlier inspection reported XS–5XL (9 selected size slots), conflicting with current visible table; must resolve actual selected status before exact group calculation.

Tote `6ad647d04f4a65e4300211e2`: 15×16 inches, 2 colors, one out of stock; exact color names inaccessible. Accessories combination count remains UNKNOWN and needs shared option semantics review.

No product edits, saves, publishing, orders or token renewal. Preserve the discrepancy; do not substitute inferred labels. Three offline plans remain BLOCKED except home arithmetic can be marked locally calculated, not accepted. Ledger unchanged 246/268 candidates, 22 UNVERIFIED; STOP ALL ON, external lock ON, automation OFF, RELEASE HOLD, Finance excluded.

## Three-group acceptance reconciliation — source-based, no provider mutations (2026-10-20)

Sources: authenticated read-only evidence comments #6286228625, #6286591812, #6286755159, #6286964033. Draft #1219 remains open at `c69f96a71a2ca207dd772db551453e8768c72074`.

**Home:** Candle `6ad647d03c2fe90c6102cb18`, 9oz and nine explicitly observed scents, yielding **9 locally calculated combinations** under Printify's stated size×option rule. This is not a provider-certified planned listing, nor shipping, pricing, rights, personalization or authorization acceptance.

**Apparel:** hoodie eight selected sizes, sweatshirt contradictory eight/nine size observations, T-shirt nine reported sizes. T-shirt/hoodie confirmed union of six color names; sweatshirt exact labels not captured and prior palette reports conflict. Exact apparel size-slot and option union therefore UNKNOWN. Do not promote the earlier provisional 26×6=156 illustration to exact count.

**Accessories:** sticker four selected sizes and tote one size with two colors (one out of stock). Shared option semantics for colorless sticker vs tote not verified. Exact Etsy combination count UNKNOWN.

**Shared operational blockers:** existing six-product listing 496>400; multi-listing shipping/pricing dependencies; disabled T-shirt personalization; expired Etsy connection; missing authoritative variant/SKU/provider/geometry/rights and installed-site acceptance.

**Engineering:** Reuse existing #1219 draft contracts; test only source-backed cases, no new PR unless reproducible defect. No criterion promotion: 246/268 implementation candidates and 22 UNVERIFIED. STOP ALL ON, external lock ON, automation OFF, RELEASE HOLD; Finance excluded.

## Six-product -> three-group OFFLINE migration specification (2026-10-20)

**Scope/authority:** planning only; owner has NOT authorized any Printify/Etsy listing changes. Source membership authenticated UI [run](https://agent.tinyfish.ai/runs/5293f5a6-5b0a-4405-8cd1-00d0c6c569d0). Existing source listing `8a2666c5-d3db-4b44-bf6a-4c5b4213815e`, primary candle, six products, Draft with unsaved changes, 496=31×16 > Etsy 400. Keep source untouched.

**Candidate groups, preserving source IDs:**
A APPAREL: hoodie `6ad647d14f4a65e4300211e4`, sweatshirt `6ad647d24f4a65e4300211e5`, T-shirt `6ad647d23c2fe90c6102cb1c`. New primary/category not approved; exact size slots and shared color-name union UNKNOWN due conflicting observations.
B HOME: soy candle `6ad647d03c2fe90c6102cb18`; 9oz and 9 named scents observed, locally calculated 9 combinations, not supplier/API-certified.
C ACCESSORIES: stickers `6ad647d01f72f1c0030e41be`, tote `6ad647d04f4a65e4300211e2`; exact option semantics UNKNOWN; tote one out-of-stock color.

**Prerequisites for any executable migration:** 1) authenticated typed shop/product/blueprint/provider/variant/SKU/placement and revision records, with snapshot hashes/timestamps; 2) exact selected options and Etsy size×union color/scent count <=400 for each proposed listing; 3) source and target Etsy listing identities, linkage graph, duplicate/SEO implications, categories and approved primary product; 4) separate shipping profile, carrier/provider costs and single-listing price propagation, explicit review of stock and manual republish notice; 5) rights/font/artwork/template and personalization eligibility; 6) valid Etsy authorization proved by allowed read-only integration checks; 7) owner-approved per-listing change plan, rollback and post-change verification. Missing inputs fail closed.

**Execution sequencing for future separately authorized operation only:** snapshot current source/linked individual listing state -> create independent draft targets -> verify target counts/options, mockups, shipping and personalization -> owner reviews -> explicitly authorize controlled publishing/migration -> verify links, stock and prices -> only then consider retiring source. None of these provider actions are authorized now.

**Codex acceptance checks (offline):** preserve all six IDs exactly once; no cross-shop bleed; enforce <=400 using selected shared-option semantics; unknown variants/rights/provider identity remain BLOCKED; prevent price/shipping shared mutation; no draft plan capable of provider execution; deterministic idempotent versioned plan and rollback manifest. Reuse #1219; no PR absent reproduced defect.

**Release:** NO RELEASE. Ledger 246/268 implementation candidates, 22 UNVERIFIED; STOP ALL ON, external lock ON, automation OFF, RELEASE HOLD; Finance excluded.
